better_radio.player.playlist_mode_help: Plays tracks from your saved playlist.
better_radio.player.free_flow_mode_help: Lets the game choose music automatically.
better_radio.player.switch_to_free_flow: Click to switch to Free flow.
better_radio.player.shuffle_help: Shuffle the playlist. Your manual queue keeps its order.
better_radio.player.free_flow_interval_h: Silence between tracks while Free flow is active, including queued tracks. Default: Balanced. Configured independently from Playlist.
better_radio.player.playlist_interval_he: Silence between tracks while Playlist is active, including the end of each loop. Default: Non-stop (2–4 seconds). Configured independently from Free flow.
better_radio.player.biome_bias_help: How strongly Free flow favors music associated with your biome. 0% gives all tracks equal weight. 100% (default) gives matching tracks three times the weight, without excluding other music.
better_radio.player.startup_mode_help: Choose the listening mode when entering a world. Changes apply on the next world session. The initial 10–15 second wait stays the same.
better_radio.player.startup.last_used_he: Start in the mode you last used. Default.
better_radio.player.startup.free_flow_he: Always start in Free flow, regardless of the last mode used.
better_radio.player.startup.playlist_hel: Always start in Playlist. Uses Free flow when no saved tracks are available.
better_radio.player.empty_history: Your played tracks will appear here.
better_radio.player.all_music_added: All available music is already in your playlist.
better_radio.player.empty_playlist: Add some music to start your playlist.
better_radio.player.save_error: Could not save your player settings. Changes are kept for this session.
